text: Follow the day’s news live Labor introducing new laws to crack down on illegal tobacco Labor will introduce new laws to make it easier to prosecute criminals involved in the illicit tobacco trade, as the government fights an uphill battle against the exploding black market. The new laws think about it as a list of observable indicators, very simple, fact-based things like: is the tobacco appropriately packaged? Is it a menthol cigarette even hiding in plain packaging? Is it being concealed? Does it have paperwork at the border? Or my personal favourite: is the retail price of this packet of cigarettes less than the amount of excise and GST combined? If any of these facts are proven, just one of them, that establishes the reasonable suspicion of the criminal offence of importing, possession, or conveying. text: Some Republicans sit out convention as others take stage to praise Trump ahead of president’s appearance Republicans look to ‘midterm convention’ to overcome Trump unpopularity Sign up for US Breaking News email Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of a longtime New Hampshire senator and former governor, has won the Democratic nomination in the race for Chris Pappas’s former House seat. title: Rhode Island’s Democratic governor loses primary amid anger over bridge
text: McKee closed the Washington bridge in December 2023, which carried about 100,000 vehicles a day, after inspectors found serious structural issues. Photograph: Boston Globe/Getty Images View image in fullscreen McKee closed the Washington bridge in December 2023, which carried about 100,000 vehicles a day, after inspectors found serious structural issues. Photograph: Boston Globe/Getty Images Rhode Island Rhode Island’s Democratic governor loses primary amid anger over bridge Helena Foulkes beats incumbent Dan McKee after criticizing handling of Providence’s Washington bridge, now expected to be completed in 2028 Lauren Gambino Wed 9 Sep 2026 20.35 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Rhode Island’s Dan McKee became the first sitting governor to lose a primary in nearly a decade, bested not by a more progressive challenger or a more youthful upset but by frustration over a bridge. McKee lost his Democratic primary to Helena Foulkes, a former longtime executive with Rhode Island-based retail pharmacy CVS, the Associated Press said on Wednesday. Several Democratic incumbents have been toppled this cycle, in a wave of anti-establishment anger that has elevated young and progressive
author: Lauren Gambino

text: Появились кадры последствий поражения украинской крылатой ракеты дальнего действия FP-5 «Фламинго» модернизированным зенитным ракетным комплексом малой дальности «Тор-М2». Сейчас «Тор-М2» и его морская модульная версия «Тор-М2КМ» в экспортном исполнении представлены на Egypt Air Show 2026 в Каире в составе экспозиции концерна ВКО «Алмаз-Антей». На опубликованном видео также демонстрируется поражение беспилотников разных типов, включая RAM-2X, Shark и «Хорнет». В декабре 2026 года производитель планирует представить модернизированный комплекс на рынке стран Юго-Восточной Азии в рамках выставки Vietnam Defence Expo.
